title.purpose: The main title and the end card. Weight 560 at width 98%, tracking -0.03em. The key phrase inside it carries the drawn vermilion underline.

h2.purpose: The H2 at the head of every beat.

still-title.purpose: The system name beside each still; the H3 voice stepped up to a fluid 1.5rem to 2rem.

lines.purpose: The three lines of Now. Weight 440, line height 1.4, measure 44rem.

lede.purpose: The line under a section title, the role line under the main title, the line under the end card. Set in ink-2.

body.purpose: Default text: still sentences, credit lines, prose.

credit.purpose: Dates, captions, state lines, the commit field footer and legend. Uppercase, tracked 0.08em, tabular figures, ink-3.

button.purpose: Both buttons and the top line's Book a call link.

nav.purpose: Top line nav links in ink-2; below 900px the nav becomes a full-field list at a fluid 1.75rem to 2.25rem, weight 540.

small.purpose: Tags, the end card's file list and the footer, in ink-3.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The exponential ease-out behind the arrival, button lift, underline draw, still wipe and cell wave.

motion.name: ease-soft
motion.purpose: Scheme change: body background and colour, top line glass, 360ms.

motion.name: fast
motion.purpose: Colour and background changes on links, buttons, icon buttons, nav.

motion.name: slow
motion.purpose: Still wipe and still hover rise.

motion.name: arrive-rise
motion.value: translateY(22px) scaleX(1.03), clip-path inset(0 0 100% 0), to rest over 820ms (opacity 600ms)
motion.purpose: Every [data-arrive] child. The scaleX settle stands in for the contract's width-axis settle because animating font-variation-settings reflows text every frame.

motion.name: arrive-stagger
motion.purpose: Children of one arrival group, indexed by --i.

motion.name: arrive-fade
motion.purpose: The data-arrive="fade" variant used by the portrait, credit rows and the commit field wrapper.

motion.name: arrive-threshold
motion.value: IntersectionObserver threshold 0.18, rootMargin 0 0 -8% 0; groups above 90% of the viewport at load reveal at once
motion.purpose: When a group reveals. Each group reveals once.

motion.name: key-underline
motion.purpose: The vermilion underline under the key phrase draws after the statement lands.

motion.name: still-wipe
motion.purpose: Stills wipe in from the left on their own clock; the clip sits on the img.

motion.name: cell-wave
motion.value: 520ms per cell, delay calc(var(--i) * 14ms) by column; settled after columns * 14ms + 600ms
motion.purpose: The commit field lights column by column, then clears its animation so hover applies.

motion.name: arrow-slide
motion.purpose: The arrow in the text button on hover.

motion.name: underline-draw
motion.value: scaleX(0) to scaleX(1) from the left over 320ms
motion.purpose: Nav links and credit titles on hover; current page link stays drawn.

motion.name: portrait-parallax
motion.value: up to 8px against the cursor, eased 12% per frame, pointer: fine only
motion.purpose: The portrait frame. Does not bind under reduced motion.

motion.name: progress
motion.value: scaleX from 0 to 1 on animation-timeline: scroll(root); JS fallback sets --progress
motion.purpose: The 1px accent hairline at the top edge.

motion.name: disclosure
motion.value: grid-template-rows 0fr to 1fr over 360ms; chevron rotates 90deg over 240ms
motion.purpose: The How it's built disclosure in a still row.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: every arrival, wipe, wave, underline and parallax at rest; smooth scroll off
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, and any page without JavaScript.

breakpoints.name: brand-role
breakpoints.purpose: Brand role hides; nav gap 1.25rem and size 0.9rem.

breakpoints.name: menu
breakpoints.purpose: Hamburger and full-field overlay nav; main title copy spans the grid and the portrait follows it at 240px square.

breakpoints.name: stills
breakpoints.purpose: Still rows stack, image first, still 260px aligned left.

breakpoints.name: credits
breakpoints.purpose: Credit rows stack with the date after the row; beat head's more button drops below the lede.

narrative.overview:
The profile reads the way a modern film title sequence tells its story. The field is near black, the type is warm off-white, and one vermilion accent is spent on three things: the underline drawn beneath the key phrase of the main title, the filled button, and the 1px progress hairline at the top edge. Systems are the cast, each with one still; the live commit field is the interlude; roles, community and education are the credits. Sections are plain words (Now, Work, Still shipping, Experience, Beyond work).

Two schemes ship. Dark is canonical and the one the tokens are written against. Light follows the system preference until the visitor chooses with the toggle in the top line; the choice is stored and applied before first paint. Both schemes are the same world at different exposures: the same face, the same voices, the same spacing, with the accent deepened in light so it holds contrast on paper.

Composition is type on the field with generous vertical space. There are no cards, no panels and no boxed sections. The only drawn rules on the page are the 1px row dividers inside credits lists and the footer's top rule. Nothing glows and nothing casts a shadow. Motion is the one place the site goes all out, and it is confined to transform, opacity and clip.
keyCharacteristics: One field, one ink family, one accent, in two exposures (dark canonical, light by preference or choice).
One variable face (Mona Sans, weight 200 to 900, width 75% to 125%) at a handful of named settings; weight and tracking carry hierarchy, never a second face or a second colour.
No containers: no cards, no bordered sections, no backgrounds behind text. Credits rows divide with a 1px hairline and nothing else.
Stills are matte objects on transparent plates (alpha baked from the render's black or white ground), so each object floats on the page with no frame, whatever sits behind it.

Everything arrives: lines rise behind a mask as the visitor scrolls, stills wipe in from the left, the commit field lights column by column. Every element is already settled without JavaScript and under reduced motion.
State is drawn by weight, line and colour within the ink ramp; the accent never marks state except on the copied email button.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Vermilion is spent on the key phrase, the filled button, the progress hairline and nothing structural. It never fills a background larger than a button, never tints a section and never marks a state other than the copied email.

rules.name: The Two Exposures Rule
rules.body: Light and dark are the same system at different exposures. A new token gets a value in both blocks, and each still ships a light-ground and a dark-ground plate selected by scheme, so stills keep floating.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is weight, width, size and tracking inside Mona Sans. No second family, no monospace, no italic voice.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Any figure inside a sentence, date line or count sits in tabular numerals (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums, the .num and .credit voices).

rules.name: The Drawn Underline Rule
rules.body: Links underline with a 1px line of their own colour. Nav links and credit row titles draw the line from the left on hover (320ms); prose links, the end card's file links and inline links carry it at rest and turn vermilion on hover.

rules.name: The No Container Rule
rules.body: Sections, stills, credits and the end card are set on the field with no background, border or panel. If a surface needs a boundary it uses space; if it needs separation inside a list it uses one line-2 hairline.

rules.name: The No Shadow Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the site casts a shadow or glows. A new surface that seems to need one uses space or weight instead.

rules.name: The Settled Without Script Rule
rules.body: The arrival exists only under html.js. Without JavaScript, and under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, every line, still, underline and cell is already at rest, parallax does not bind, and smooth scrolling is off.

rules.name: The Width Settle Rule
rules.body: The contract described a width-axis settle from 110 to 100. The build substitutes scaleX(1.03) resolving to 1, because animating font-variation-settings reflows the text every frame. New motion follows the same constraint: transform, opacity and clip only; nothing that animates layout.

dos: Do set every new element in Mona Sans at one of the named voices; add a voice only when a reused role has no fit.
Do give every new colour a value in both scheme blocks and keep the two exposures parallel.
Do compose with vertical space; separate items in a list with one line-2 hairline.
Do keep new motion on transform, opacity and clip, on the exponential ease-out, settled under reduced motion and without JavaScript.

Do give each new system still the shared ground: one object centred at about 55% of a 1024px square, matte off-white on a pure black plate and matte charcoal-grey on a pure white plate, aligned to each other, with its provenance sidecar.
Do keep figures in tabular numerals inside sentences, and only figures that profile.yaml carries.
donts: Don't add cards, panels, bordered sections or background tints behind text.
Don't add shadows, glows, gradients or lit edges.
Don't spend the accent on anything beyond the key phrase, the filled button, the progress hairline, the Book a call link and list markers.
Don't introduce a second face, a monospace voice or glyph icons; icons come from the drawn 1.75-stroke set.
Don't animate font-variation-settings, width, height or any layout property.
Don't add stat tiles, repeated numerals, timelines or kicker labels above headings; the headings are the labels.
